posts.title: The Only Code That Defies Entropy
posts.description: A developer explores the Second Law of Thermodynamics and finds that love is the only code capable of creating local order against universal entropy.

posts.title: Keep Up the Good Work, No, I Love You
posts.description: A son reflects on his inability to express affection due to his Busan upbringing and realizes the hidden depth of his parents love after having a child.

posts.title: I Treat This Job as a Hobby
posts.description: Adopting a gaming mindset to reduce stress and increase performance by viewing the job as a sophisticated hobby rather than a survival necessity.
